notes.title: Rise of the Ronin Steam® version Update Ver. 1.09.0.1 (03/14/2025)
notes.content:
■ System Updates and Adjustments
・Adjusted the settings of presets.
Settings that heavily effect performance have been adjusted within the preset.
You can manually increase individual settings.
・Added ”Recommended” preset 
The recommended preset is the most suitable based on the specifications of your PC.
・Adjusted name of setting "FPS Limit" to "FPS"
This option will lock the FPS to the set number. We have adjusted the wording of the setting for better accuracy.
We have also added supplementary explanations to highlight its impact to performance.

■ Bug fixes
・Fixed an issue where the game would crash on launch, for CPUs with 33 threads and above
・Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck loading in specific situations
・Fixed stuttering issues in specific stages and circumstances
・Fixed an issue where interacting with the Veiled Edge Banner under specific circumstances would lead to crashes
・Fixed an issue where inputting directional keys when receiving "Midnight" rewards in the Testament of the Soul would lead to getting trapped in the menu
・Fixed an issue where selecting OPTIONS rapidly at the title screen would disable further input

notes.title: "Rise of the Ronin" Now Available!
notes.content:
The Bakumatsu era open-world action RPG Rise of the Ronin, is now available! 

In Rise of the Ronin, fans will play as a ronin in 1853 Japan in turmoil. With Japan’s fate now in their hands, players will encounter various historical figures and factions with differing ideologies, and make significant decisions such as whether to confront or defend them. Players will also be able to form special relationships with some characters thanks to the “Veiled Vow” system, which will allow them to freely shape their own experience of the Bakumatsu period.

New Features Exclusive to the Steam® Version:
- 8K resolution support
- DirectX 12 Ultimate support
- Ultra-wide and super ultra-wide monitor compatibility
- 120fps support
- Ray tracing support
- 3D audio support
- Customizable keyboard and mouse controls
- AMD Fidelity FX Super Resolution support
- NVIDIA DLSS and Reflex support
- UI menu with mouse clickability
- Intel XeSS graphics technology support

notes.title: "Rise of the Ronin" set to be released on March 11, 2025. Pre-order now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the Steam® version of the open-world action RPG "Rise of the Ronin," will be available on March 11, 2025. Pre-orders have also begun today!

"Rise of the Ronin" is an RPG set in the Bakumatsu period in Japan, developed by Team NINJA, known for the "Nioh" and "NINJA GAIDEN" series. Players take on the role of a ronin, forging their own destiny in an open world. The game features multiple possible endings, allowing players to choose which faction to support—such as the anti-shogunate faction, pro-shogunate faction, or Western forces—which significantly alters the story's outcome.

The Steam® version will support various PC features, including ultra-wide monitor compatibility. It will also include enhancements such as 8K resolution, 120FPS, 3D audio, and customizable keyboard and mouse settings, enriching the gaming experience.

New Features Exclusive to the Steam® Version:
- 8K resolution support
- DirectX 12 Ultimate support
- Ultra-wide and super ultra-wide monitor compatibility
- 120FPS support
- Ray tracing support
- 3D audio support
- Customizable keyboard and mouse controls
- AMD Fidelity FX Super Resolution support
- NVIDIA DLSS and Reflex support
- UI menu with mouse clickability
- Intel XeSS graphics technology support
